verdict.rationale: Autumn has a first-party webhooks page describing an outbound event that fires when a customer's plans change (new subscriptions, upgrades, downgrades), with use cases like triggering workflows and syncing external systems. The pack does not show how endpoints are registered, how many event types exist, or how payloads are delivered and verified, so coverage is incomplete. missing for 10: documented endpoint registration/subscription mechanism, full event-type catalog beyond plan changes, payload schema and signature verification/retry details, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Fired whenever a customer's plans change — new subscriptions, upgrades, downgrades, etc.
webhooks are helpful for: Sending activation emails ... Triggering workflows ... Syncing with external systems
